thread:
tess: Quick run-through for next Wed's webinar — need to lock registration page, Zoom config, recording pipeline, and post-event follow-up. Live reg page by Mon EOD ideally. Owners and blockers? :small_blue_diamond:
jordan: I can own the reg page. plan: Webflow form -> HubSpot sync -> thank-you page with on-demand link placeholder. Will set UTM params.
maya: For Zoom: we need cloud recording + auto-transcript, meeting passcode off (we use registration), and ‘alternative hosts’ set to samir. Also enable captioning.
samir: Copy that. I'll be alt-host and will start the recording checklist. We should set recording to "Record to cloud" and enable automatic transcript. Also set retention to 30 days in Zoom admin.
zoe: Post-event: 1) 24h follow-up email with key clip + transcript summary, 2) 3-day nurture with deeper benchmark content, 3) On-demand page updated with full recording + chaptered clips. Who's doing clip edits?
jordan: I can export timestamps from the recording and add basic chapters. Need someone for the teaser clip (30-60s).
tess: @jordan clip export + chapters. @maya please confirm cloud recording uploads to S3 bucket 'events-prod' or we point Zoom -> Zapier -> S3?
maya: We have a Zoom direct-to-S3 integration via Ops account (preferred). I'll confirm folder path and ACL. Naming conv: redwood-webinar-<YYYYMMDD>-<model>-full.mp4
samir: Will add to my checklist: set Zoom recording topic prefix, enable automatic upload, and set alternative host to myself. Also will toggle "Optimize the recording for 3rd-party transcriptions".
jordan: For reg page: add hidden fields: utm_source, utm_campaign, webinar_id=rw-infer-0426. Also include a checkbox for sharing recording (GDPR opt-in).
zoe: HubSpot workflow: On registrant -> add to list, send reminder 24h and 1h before. Post-event trigger: on recording available -> send 24h follow-up (clip + TL;DR + link to transcript). Who will wire the HubSpot trigger?
jordan: I'll wire the registration-to-HubSpot mapping, but need @samir or @maya to post the recording URL into CMS or S3 so the webhook can pick it up.
tess: Clips owner? assigning to @jordan for chaptering, @maya for raw upload, and @samir to run final recording QA. @zoe you own email copy and nurture sequence.
zoe: Got it — drafting follow-up copy now. Will use these subject options: "Recording + TL;DR from Redwood Inference" or "Thanks — watch the 5-minute highlights". Leaning toward short subject to improve opens.
jordan: Zoom settings (snippet):
```
Recording: Record to cloud
Transcription: Auto-transcribe enabled
Breakout rooms: disabled for webinar
Alternative host: samir@redwood.ai
Passcode: not required (registration enforced)
```
maya: Also enable "Allow cloud recordings to be shared" in account settings, and set default recording layout to "Active speaker + shared screen".
ops-bot: Reminder: Zoom integration scheduled to run upload at 12:05pm UTC after webinar.
samir: Quick note — please remind registrants in the reminder email to whitelist *@redwood.ai* so they get the follow-ups and the recording link.
tess: Can we get a volunteer to trim a 45-60s social clip within 24h? This is critical to our paid ads.
jordan: I can do rough cut in 24h, but need raw cloud file available immediately after processing.
zoe: I'll add social cut to the follow-up task list and the creative brief. @maya can you add a public S3 URL and set a short-lived CDN link for the writer?
maya: Yup, will provide an amber link (48h) then we move to permanent location. Also will turn on auto-captioning export to .vtt.
tess: Outstanding blockers: Zoom pass-through to S3 confirmed by @maya, HubSpot webhook owner for recording = @jordan, clip editor = @jordan, email copy = @zoe, social creative brief = @zoe. Anything else? :memo:
jordan: Need a staging reg page URL for QA. I'll post by tomorrow noon.
zoe: I'll send the reminder email drafts by EOD today for quick review.
samir: I'll run a dry-run on Friday with recording test and transcript check. Please join if you want to validate.
ops-bot: Event created in calendar: Webinar "Runtime Economics for LLMs" — 2026-04-26 17:00 UTC. Recording webhook: queued.
tess: Perfect — I'll compile action-item list and ping folks in the project board. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
